chunks: And We made her an example for those before her and those after her, and a lesson for those who fear God.

key_terms.لِلْمُتَّقِينَ: for those who are God-conscious or pious
key_terms.نَكَالًا: an example or model for imitation or warning

ai.seo_question: Who is considered an example (nakal) for all generations in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt, whose lives serve as a 'nakal' (exemplar or warning) for all preceding and succeeding generations. It underscores their dual role as a moral guide for the Muttaqin and a cautionary tale for those who neglect divine guidance, reinforcing the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) in the Prophet's family.
